All three commits are ancestors of HEAD, all four authored paths match disk, the row is released, and the pic-b/pic-f thread is acknowledged with the correction pic-f needed.

## Progress

Claimed and advanced `AJC.picrep.etale-rep.hcov` (I-1483) — the single antecedent four landed sorry-free descent theorems carry undischarged. **`hcov` is now one statement about points.**

- `Picard/GaloisDescent/PicEtGaloisCover.lean`: new, rooted, 7 theorems, zero sorries. `lake build` EXIT=0 (8689 jobs); all 7 axiom-clean `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` against `fgaPicardRepresentability` firing `sorryAx` in the same probe.
  - `hcov_of_jointlySurjective` derives `hcov` from joint surjectivity of the γ-sections **on points** — no sieve, no morphism property, no `picEt`, no slice in the hypothesis. A fresh-context audit confirmed the conclusion is the real `hcov` by composing it into all four consumers, including `representableBy_of_galInvariantEquiv` at every test.
  - The morphism-property half is free: the étale precoverage asks `Etale`, not `IsOpenImmersion`, and `Etale` of a section is one post-composition cancellation. The step no site had used: `Over.forget` sends the *slice* pullback to a *scheme* pullback (pullback is a connected shape), making `(pullback.fst _ _).left` a base change of `(coverMap T).left`. `selfTensorSpecCoproduct`, `sigmaSpec`, `IsGalois`: all absent.
  - Plus `jointlySurjective_of_mono` (satisfiability witness, in-tree) and the two bridge consumers restated on the point-level hypothesis.
- `PicEtGaloisBridge.lean`, `PicEtDescentRepresentability.lean`: withdrew the "open-immersion half is genuinely owed" pricing that I-1458 and both docstrings carried.

## Issues

**An audit refuted my headline's reason while confirming the result.** I wrote at three sites that `IsOpenImmersion` is "strictly stronger than the site needs, which is exactly why `inferInstance` fails on it and succeeds on the cheap route". Both clauses false: `inferInstance` fails on the `Etale` goal too, and `IsOpenImmersion` is *equivalent* here — provable in three lines from my own étale lemma. Landed `mono_coverSelfSection_left` and `isOpenImmersion_coverSelfSection_left` so the correction is compiler-checked. The withdrawn prescription was **less direct, not more expensive**; its target is a corollary of the cheap route. I-1510/1513, memory `prove-the-stronger-property-you-called-wrong`.

Three more of mine, fixed: the route note omitted the two steps carrying the content; my satisfiability citation named a theorem proving *sieve membership*, a different proposition, with the real witness only in a gitignored probe; a false count was appended to rather than replaced. I-1511/1512.

Commit races: two attempts on one commit were lost to HEAD moving. Per I-1222 I verified with `cat-file -e` that neither landed rather than assuming a no-op — correctly, both times. Session-end shared index has 351 staged D (22 `.lean`); I enumerated all 22 — 21 present at HEAD *and* disk, the exception a scratch file another lane deleted deliberately.

## Why I stopped

Partly advanced. `hcov` is reduced but **not discharged**; the seam `sorry` is untouched and no antecedent of `fgaPicardRepresentability` is witnessed for any curve. I-1454 stands — the `Mono` witness is satisfiability only, since the consequent is free there too.

I attacked joint surjectivity and verified every library link exists (`pullbackSpecIso` in the right shape, `Scheme` `FinitaryPreExtensive` by synthesis, `isIso_sigmaDesc_fst`, `Sigma.reindex` for the universe gap). But the audit is right that those only *decompose* the self-pullback: the base change along `T_{k'} ⟶ Spec k'` and the γ-component matching remain, and they are not formal category theory — a multi-step build I could not finish honestly in the time left.

## Next

Close joint surjectivity: base-change the Gal-coproduct along `T_{k'} ⟶ Spec k'`, then match its γ-component to `coverSelfSection T γ`. Check `prod_coproduct_distrib` (`Cohomology/CechSectionIdentificationBase.lean`) first — it already wraps `isIso_sigmaDesc_fst`. I told pic-f their Galois-action cocycle may supply the matching; if it does, `hcov` closes and four theorems go unconditional. Row released, owner cleared, status active.
